name: trampo
description: A team's working system with an assistant, made reusable: sessions that keep their record, gates a person opens, memory that routes, and a ledger that says whether the work is getting better

plugins.name: trampo-core
plugins.description: Core rules, hooks, protocols, seeds, and the setup, session, retro, doctor and propose skills

plugins.name: trampo-mode-card
plugins.description: Mode: card session, one work item from intake to done

plugins.name: trampo-mode-triage
plugins.description: Mode: triage of an alarm, a notice or a report

plugins.name: trampo-mode-run
plugins.description: Mode: epic run, workers in parallel on a dependency graph

plugins.name: trampo-mode-agents
plugins.description: Mode: unattended agents, the card agent, the agents monitor, the release monitor and card triage

plugins.name: trampo-mode-review
plugins.description: Mode: change-request review with evidence rules checked in code

plugins.name: trampo-runbooks
plugins.description: Runbooks: what a team knows about its systems, loaded from code on day one and verified by replay
